title: Mixed Event — Rise as One! — Episode2 Pooch Party

meta.Event Outline: On one of his daily runs, Akito has an encounter with a dog and his owner. The pair has been training day by day in the hopes of one day winning a national disc dog competition. But the day before their next competition, this dog owner sprains his ankle...

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Phew... Let's end practice here for today.
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay!
Whew! I worked up a good sweat!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Nice work today. You all sounded great. You really stayed focused until the end.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you, Miku. I think we were able to because you were all here to watch.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, Honami...
Can we work on the interlude together sometime? We kinda fell out of tempo for a second there...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, I was actually going to ask you the same thing.
In that case, why don't we meet here early tomorrow?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay. What time do you wanna start?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Let's see... I should be done walking Shibao around nine, so how about a little bit after that?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sounds good. Then let's meet half past nine.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Right. I forgot that you still have to take Shibao out for walks even on your days off.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, taking care of a dog sounds like a lot of work.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, it does!
You'd get tired of it so fast, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Look who's talking.
You're always staying up so late that you can't wake up at a normal time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait a second. I feel like your walks with Shibao used to end much earlier...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, she's right!
The last time we all went out for a walk together, I wanna say we were back by around eight...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, the thing is...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: When he went in for his regular checkup the other day, the vet told us that he's overweight. So, during my days off, I try to take him to the dog park.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, really?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Is everything okay with Shibao...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, the vet said that he'll be just fine as long as he exercises regularly.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, that's good to hear...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hang on. KAITO, have you met Shibao before?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, um...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You two became friends during Operation: Babysit Bashi, right?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Bashi...? Did you really need to come up with a weird nickname for Shibao?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What? It's not weird. It's cute!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I like it since it rhymes with Sakki♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, Operation: Babysit Bashi...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, the other day, I had to keep an eye on Shibao all by myself because everyone else at home was gone...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But we had practice that day, so I couldn't stay by his side all day...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I was a little worried since Shibao isn't used to spending a lot of time on his own.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That was when KAITO agreed to watch Bashi while Hona went off to practice☆

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She left a tablet he could keep watch from in her room. That way, he could tell her right away if anything happened to Shibao.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, KAITO, why you?
Do you secretly like dogs or something?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Umm... I was told that someone on the animal caretaker committee should volunteer.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Someone on the animal caretaker committee...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The truth is, we've been copying all of you in terms of committee assignments.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, really?!
Oh, does that mean one of you is on the school festival planning committee like me...?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yup!
It's not exactly the same, but Len and I are on the fun and games committee!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: To be fair, it wasn't meant to be all that serious. It's just a convenient way for us to divide up the work around here. For example, Luka's on the cleanup committee, so she'd lead if we needed to do some tidying up.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Which is how we decided that a member of the animal caretaker committee should help sit Shibao.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you very much again for keeping an eye on Shibao for me that time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Please come visit again sometime.
I'm sure he'd love to see you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
He would...?
In that case, it might be nice to join you two for one of your walks.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, speaking of walks...
Hanasato and I will be taking Shibao and Samo on one together this Saturday.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Samo's Minori's dog, right?!
That sounds like fun! It'll be like a double date! A double walk...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Come to think of it, I remember Minori saying that Samo gets really excited and tugs on his leash whenever he sees Shibao.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Shibao too.
He always wants to go home after we've walked for a while, but the opposite happens whenever he's with Samo.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. That sounds like just the sort of exercise he needs.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I hope you two have a great walk, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me too!
A few days later
Nonogi Park
se_run_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Phew...
That should be enough for today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, I haven't seen Ishihara or Max at all today...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(That explains why things seemed so quiet.
They always practice here around this time...)
Woof! Woof!
*Bark*

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(So much for peace and quiet.
I hear two dogs, but don't see them anywhere...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wah! Samo, I know you're excited to see Shibao, but you need to settle down! This isn't safe!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. It has been a little while.
Shibao's tail won't stop wagging.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, you're right! Hehe. That's so cute...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, it's Hanasato alright...

rows.Speaker: Minori's Voice
rows.Line: Huh? Shinonome?!

rows.Speaker: Honami's Voice
rows.Line: What?
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Good morning, Shinonome!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: M-Morning...
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Um, Hanasato?
This person is...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, lemme introduce you guys!
This is Akito Shinonome. He sings with Kohane as part of the same team.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
With Kohane...?
Oh, I think I remember seeing your team perform at Shibuya Festa.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's nice to meet you. My name is Honami Mochizuki. I'm in the same year as Hanasato.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, um... It's nice to meet you as well...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Why does it seem like everyone who comes up to talk to me like this owns a dog...?)

rows.Speaker: Shibao
rows.Line: Woof?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm sorry, but are you not all that fond of dogs, Shinonome...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! I-Is that true?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
No, uh...
It's not that I dislike them or anything...

rows.Speaker: Max
rows.Line: Woof! Woof!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, you're...

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: No, Max, don't go that way!

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: Shinonome doesn't like dogs, remember?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
S-So it is true...!
I'm so sorry, Shinonome! I really had no idea!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's okay, really...

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: I-I'm sorry, Shinonome...!

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: I know you're excited about tomorrow's competition, Max, but you need to behave yourself...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Competition?

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right.
We're taking part in a disc dog competition.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! That has dogs jumping in the air and stuff to catch discs, right?! Your dog must be really agile!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Agile enough to be in a competition...
I wish you both the best of luck.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
Thank you very much!
Alright, Max, let's start practicing... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: What's wrong? Why aren't you moving?

rows.Speaker: Max
rows.Line: Woof...

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: You don't hate flying discs all of a sudden, do you? Ready? Come this way!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Is it just me, or is Ishihara's ankle...?)

rows.Speaker: Max
rows.Line: Woof! Woof...!

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: No, don't yank on your leash like that!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I knew it...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ishihara, did you hurt your ankle...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: N-No, I'm okay... It's just...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But it looks like you're not putting any weight on your left side.
